messages:
rachel: Heads-up: small but important docs + SDK notice going out — we renamed the embeddings param `dim` -> `vector_size` to make intent clearer. We'll also default telemetry to opt-out for SDKs by default starting next month. Please review migration instructions and legal blurb.
omar: What's the timeline for the param rename? any runtime compat shims planned?
tia: Timeline: announce today, 45-day soft-warning period where both names are accepted (with deprecation warnings), then hard-sunsetting at 120 days. We will ship a lightweight shim in SDK v3.2 that accepts `dim` and maps it to `vector_size` while logging `sdk.param.renamed` telemetry.
rachel: Telemetry change: SDKs will default telemetry off (opt-out) in 30 days; existing users keep current setting until they upgrade. We added migration docs showing how to enable telemetry per environment.
docs-bot: Docs build OK: staging deploy 5012 :white_check_mark: — playbook at https://internal.redwood.dev/docs/embeddings-param-rename-and-telemetry
alex: Can we include quick grep/sed snippets for large repos to rename `dim` to `vector_size` safely? Some partners have generated SDK calls in codegen.
tia: Added examples: sed one-liner, Python 2-line refactor, and an AST-based codemod for JS/TS. Example: `git grep -n "\bdim=\"" | xargs -I{} sed -i 's/dim=/vector_size=/g' {}` with caveats.
compliance: Telemetry opt-out default change is fine but ensure EU customers get explicit opt-in screen in Console and we document retention and schema. Added language in Compliance section.
omar: Any model compatibility impact for downstream embeddings services?
tia: None — this is purely a client param rename. We updated compatibility matrix to indicate which SDK versions understand both names. Also included test checklist so teams can run a small validation: generate embeddings with both params and compare shapes.
rachel: Plan: publish the playbook now, announce in #sdk-announcements, and open a follow-up thread for partner outreach. If no objections, publishing in 15m. :rocket:
